mode.title: Mode
mode.description: tokens = the security profile of each token contract. holders = the top holders and liquidity providers behind a token. address = check a wallet or contract address for reported malicious activity.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Which chain the addresses are on. Solana is assessed with a different property set to the EVM chains, because the two work differently.

tokenAddresses.title: Token contract addresses
tokenAddresses.description: Token contracts to check, on the chain selected above. Used by the tokens and holders modes.

walletAddresses.title: Wallet or contract addresses
walletAddresses.description: Address mode only. Wallets or contracts to check for reported phishing, theft, laundering and similar.

topHolders.title: How many holders
topHolders.description: Holders mode. How many top holders and liquidity providers to return per token.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
